name: Flip Side
hint: One switch, two gates: when one opens, the other shuts.
why4: The block is marked 4, and it is the only way up the 4-high plateau.
solution: P4 hops the 4-block, stands against gate A at x=15 and jumps into the switch above it (x=16): gate A opens, gate E (x=25) closes. P4 hops back over the block.
Conga-push the 4-block right: P4 against it at x=8, P3, P2, P1 behind; push it through A until it rests against E (block at x=23-24); everyone is now inside the chamber.
P1 steps back to x=17 (right of gate A) and jumps into the switch: A closes, E opens.
Conga-push the block on through E until it stops against the plateau wall (block at x=32-33).
Everyone climbs: floor -> block (2) -> plateau (2). P4 touches the key at x=40; jump the 2-wide pit at x=44-45; P4 opens the door at x=48; all press Down.
Recovery: the switch can be flipped back from either side at any time.
